about: A preset and each half of Serum 2's saved state are one container: a JSON header, then a CBOR tree compressed with Zstandard. The tree is a map of numbered sections (Oscillator0, Env1, FXRack0, ModSlot12 …). A section's plainParams holds only the knobs that differ from their defaults, in Serum's own units, or the text "default". Wavetables, samples, multisamples and impulses are named by path relative to Serum's folders, never embedded. The saved state splits the preset's sections between the processor (the sound) and the controller (the window, the preset's name, the defaults each FX unit started from); a preset holds both in one tree. Host parameters: Serum 2 lists 2,623 to a VST3 host, the same names and order whatever the patch: 538 for the synth, then one per MIDI controller (CC 0 to 127 on 16 channels, pitch bend and aftertouch per channel). Its FX units have no parameters of their own: the 16 'FX Main Param' and 2 × 16 'FX Bus Param' slots stand for whatever the rack holds. Macro names follow the patch's macro labels.

layers: the header: JSON with fileType, presetName, presetAuthor, presetDescription, tags, product, productVersion, version (the format's own number), vendor, url and hash. Older files count a NUL inside the length.
u32 LE: the body's length once decoded
u32 LE: the body's encoding, 2 (Zstandard) in every file seen
the body, Zstandard-compressed, to the end of the file. The header's hash is the MD5 of these bytes.
decoded: one CBOR map of sections, which repeats the header's fields
the VST3 processor's state: the same container, its header naming component "processor" with no preset name or tags
Live keeps it as hex in the Set's Vst3Preset/ProcessorState
Live writes it as a .vstpreset's Comp chunk when the device is dragged into its browser
the VST3 controller's state: the same container, its header naming component "controller" and the preset's name, author and description
Live keeps it as hex in the Set's Vst3Preset/ControllerState
Live writes it as a .vstpreset's Cont chunk when the device is dragged into its browser

modulation.about: Serum 2.1.5's mod matrix: 64 slots, ModSlot0–63 (host parameters Mod 1–64 Amount/Out). A slot stores source as [source, aux source] (0 is none), its destination four ways (destModuleTypeString, destModuleID, destModuleParamID, destModuleParamName) and in plainParams kParamAmount (-100–100 %, default 0), kParamOut (output scaling, 0–100 %, default 100) and kParamBipolar (1 when bipolar, which maps the source to -1…1). Serum saves nothing of a slot without a source. On load it resolves a destination by its stored name and saves back its own number. A destination is verified when a slot naming it reloads, saves back unchanged and, driven by Macro 1 at amount ±100, changes the rendered note; a source is verified when exactly one stimulus moved a slot routed from it. See range-verification.json.
